p: countervail the king's damage: Haman could not profit the king by his malice as much he would hinder him by the loss of the Jews and the tribute which he had from them.
evil determined against him by the: His conscience accused him that as he had conspired the death of innocents, so the vengeance of God would fall on him for the same.
fallen upon the bed whereon Esther: He fell down at the couch on which she sat and made request for his life.
covered Haman's face: This was the manner of the Persians, when one was out of favour with the king.
good for the king: Who discovered the conspiracy against the king, Es 2:21,22.
